Name: AT - Witchy Terrariums - Bog Style Coop Retexture
Author: ashleyketchumtr
Description:
[center][img]https://imgur.com/cqmLUbs.png[/img]

﻿[img]https://imgur.com/yhGEUJb.png[/img]﻿

[b][font=Verdana][font=Georgia][size=3]Transform your coop into a magical terrarium with this seasonal replacement mod! Perfect for housing your dinos or any custom coop animals![/size][/font][size=4][font=Georgia]
[/font][/size][/font][/b][font=Georgia]
This mod utilizes the enchanting assets created by the talented [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/about-me]BogWyytch[/url], used with her kind permission. Dive into a mystical bog-inspired environment that changes with the seasons, bringing a touch of magic to your farm. Do yourself a favor and download all of her mods!
[/font][font=Georgia]
[b][u]Features[/u][/b][/font]
[font=Georgia][b]Seasonal Variations:[/b] Enjoy a beautiful terrarium that changes with each season. I have edited the coop buildings to have ghost frogs, that match Bog’s animals, on the sign and side of the building, replacing the eggs.
The frog colors change with the season as well! 
[/font][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][b]
Pepper Rex Friendly:[/b] A unique and charming home for your prehistoric pets.
[font=Georgia][b]Compatible with Custom Animals:[/b] Ideal for mods that add custom farm animals, such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20657]Frog Friends[/url]﻿ (will not work to replace their terrarium, but their froggies work in coops), [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23519]The Witch's Familiars[/url] (Junishrooms & Toad), or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19404]Ilucie's Hermit Crabs[/url]![/font][/font][/font]
[font=Georgia]

[img]https://imgur.com/WIj4nRN.png[/img]﻿

[/font]Ensure you have[b] Alternative Textures[/b] installed.
[font=Georgia]Download and extract into your Mods folder.[/font]
Purchase the [b]paint bucket[/b] from Robin to apply the new designs.


[img]https://imgur.com/XFFVd77.png[/img]﻿
